title: TLSClientCertificateInfo
description: TLSClientCertificateInfo holds the client TLS certificate info configuration.

issuer.description: Issuer defines the client certificate issuer details to add to the X-Forwarded-Tls-Client-Cert-Info header.

commonName.description: CommonName defines whether to add the organizationalUnit information into the issuer.

country.description: Country defines whether to add the country information into the issuer.

domainComponent.description: DomainComponent defines whether to add the domainComponent information into the issuer.

locality.description: Locality defines whether to add the locality information into the issuer.

organization.description: Organization defines whether to add the organization information into the issuer.

province.description: Province defines whether to add the province information into the issuer.

serialNumber.description: SerialNumber defines whether to add the serialNumber information into the issuer.

notAfter.description: NotAfter defines whether to add the Not After information from the Validity part.

notBefore.description: NotBefore defines whether to add the Not Before information from the Validity part.

sans.description: Sans defines whether to add the Subject Alternative Name information from the Subject Alternative Name part.

serialNumber.description: SerialNumber defines whether to add the client serialNumber information.

subject.description: Subject defines the client certificate subject details to add to the X-Forwarded-Tls-Client-Cert-Info header.

commonName.description: CommonName defines whether to add the organizationalUnit information into the subject.

country.description: Country defines whether to add the country information into the subject.

domainComponent.description: DomainComponent defines whether to add the domainComponent information into the subject.

locality.description: Locality defines whether to add the locality information into the subject.

organization.description: Organization defines whether to add the organization information into the subject.

organizationalUnit.description: OrganizationalUnit defines whether to add the organizationalUnit information into the subject.

province.description: Province defines whether to add the province information into the subject.

serialNumber.description: SerialNumber defines whether to add the serialNumber information into the subject.
